## SCANVI annotation

```{r}
library(anndata)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
```

# Cell type annotation

The reference matrix was generated based on Andersen's and Rayon's paper. Please refer to 02_scANVI_reference_training.py (reference model) and 04_scANVI_label_transfer.py (label transfer) for details.

```{r eval=TRUE}
merged_filt_obj <- readRDS("../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_seurat_obj.RDS")
# logNormalize to be consistent with the reference dataset
# though SCVI tools does not use normalized counts (only raw), there are post processing steps that require it, like PCA (?).
DefaultAssay(merged_filt_obj) <- 'RNA'
merged_filt_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_filt_obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

# join layers to export the full raw counts matrix for all samples (layers)
merged_filt_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(merged_filt_obj[["RNA"]])
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# create an anndata object with transposed counts matrices
ipsc_adata <- AnnData(
  X = t(as.matrix(LayerData(merged_filt_obj, assay = 'RNA', layer = "data"))), 
  obs = as.data.frame(merged_filt_obj@meta.data),
  layers = list(counts = t(as.matrix(LayerData(merged_filt_obj,assay = 'RNA', layer = "counts"))))
)
# Add matching columns for the celltype annotation from reference dataset
ipsc_adata$obs$dataset <- "iPSC"
ipsc_adata$obs$donor <- ipsc_adata$obs$orig.ident

anndata::write_h5ad(ipsc_adata, "../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_normalized_adata_obj.h5ad")
```

```{r fig.width = 10}
ipsc_obj <- readRDS( "../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_SCT_seurat_obj.RDS")
# scanvi_query <- readRDS("../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_scanvilabeled_seurat_obj.RDS")
# scanvi_query
scanvi_query_adata <- anndata::read_h5ad("../results/scanvi/Andersen_Rayon_sub_tranferred_ipsc_data_umap.h5ad")

ipsc_obj[['scanvi']] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = scanvi_query_adata$obsm[['X_scANVI']] %>%
                                             set_rownames(scanvi_query_adata$obs_names),
                                             key = "scanvi_",
                                             assay = 'RNA')
ipsc_obj <- AddMetaData(ipsc_obj, scanvi_query_adata$obs$predictions_scanvi, col.name = "predictions_scanvi")
ipsc_obj@meta.data <- ipsc_obj@meta.data %>% # 86954
  mutate(new_consolidated_annotation = case_when(
    predictions_scanvi %in% c("Alpha motor neurons (a-MN)", "Gamma motor neurons (g-MN)") ~ "Motor neurons (MN)",
    predictions_scanvi %in% c("Ventral fibrous astrocytes (VFA)") ~ "Astrocytes (AC)",
    predictions_scanvi == "iPSCs/NPC" ~ "Neuroepithelial cells (NEP)",
    TRUE ~ predictions_scanvi))
# DimPlot(ipsc_obj, reduction = "scanvi")

ipsc_obj[["umap.scanvi"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = scanvi_query_adata$obsm[['X_umap']] %>%
    set_rownames(scanvi_query_adata$obs_names),
  key = "UMAPscanvi_",
  assay = "RNA"
)

DimPlot(ipsc_obj, reduction = "umap.scanvi", group.by = "new_consolidated_annotation")

DimPlot(ipsc_obj, reduction = "umap.scanvi", group.by = "orig.ident")
saveRDS(ipsc_obj, "../results/iPSC_filtered_merged_soupX_scanvilabeled_seurat_obj_juyoung.RDS")
```
